text:
Ava (CS): Heads-up: Early integration for HelixCare in staging showing a repeating pattern: first request after deploy OK, then a burst of 401s for ~20-40s, followed by 429s as the app retries. They put an internal edge-proxy in front of their service just before the failures started.
Theo (Eng): Can you paste the SDK startup line and an example 401 response body? Sounds like ephemeral token churn or a mint stampede.
Ava (CS): SDK init: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, env: 'staging' })`
Ava (CS): 401 payload sample: `401 {"error":"invalid_token","reason":"expired"}` then lots of `429 Too Many Requests` within seconds. They say the proxy is issuing short-lived JWTs (5s TTL).
Rina (Support): 5s TTL + concurrent pod starts is a recipe for stampede. If many processes call proxy to mint a token simultaneously, proxy will fanout to our auth endpoint and we might hit rateback. Also small TTL + clock skew can trigger early expiry.
Theo (Eng): Two-pronged fix to recommend: reduce fanout at the proxy (cache short window + singleflight) and add client-side mitigations (stagger startup, backoff on 401). Request we also get request-id from the first 401 so we can trace.
Ava (CS): They said their deploy brings up ~25 pods in ~60s. I'll ask for first 401 request-id and the (trimmed) Authorization header.
Theo (Eng): Quick checklist to send:
- Enable short token cache in proxy: cache minted token for ~6-10s to avoid immediate re-mint.
- Implement singleflight/mutex per host so only one token mint occurs concurrently.
- Add jitter before refresh/mint: `sleep(random(0,700ms))`.
- Adjust deployment rollout to stagger pod startups by 1-3s if possible.
- Increase ephemeral token TTL to >= 10s while they stabilize.
- Client: add retry-backoff for 401s with exponential backoff and cap retries.
- Verification: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health` should return 200 and an X-Request-Id header.
Ava (CS): They'll also ask if we can temporarly soften staging limits while they deploy config changes. They requested ~2 hours.
Rina (Support): We can request an infra quota bump for staging for a short window. I'll open INF ticket and include org id + env label; propose +30% QPS to the token endpoint for 2h.
infra-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-8492 for provisional staging rate-limit bump (2 hours) requested by Rina (Support).
Theo (Eng): Also ask them to capture the `exp` and `iat` from the token (trim signature) so we can validate TTL math. If `exp - iat` is wrong, there's a mint bug.
Ava (CS): Sending checklist and trace instructions now. I'll update when they test proxy cache and rollout splay. Thanks team :raised_hands:
Rina (Support): Noted. I'll add the org id to INF-8492 and monitor during the window. If we see other orgs impacted we'll revert.
Ava (CS): Appreciate it. Will post results here after their next deploy.
